Maximum amount of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_agent]]agents[[/col]] an AI army will aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\n[[col:white]]2[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_artillery]]artillery[[/col]] units an AI army will aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]20[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_cavalryAndMonsters]]cavalry & monster[[/col]] units an AI army will aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_meleeInfantry]]melee infantry[[/col]] units an AI army will aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]60[[/col]] by default.

Base amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in an army.\\n\\nA unit's [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost is identical to its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Bonus amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/col]]Army Supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units, per level of the commanding [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_general]]general[[/col]].\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Enables [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for AI armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nWhen an army is restricted, if the AI attempts to recruit a new unit in it, some of its existing units are disbanded to remain within the limit.\\nThe AI is reimbursed for the cost of disbanded units.\\n\\nUnits are removed in the following order until [[img:icon_merc]]Army Supplies[[/img]] are no longer exceeded:\\n- Excess [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_agent]]agents[[/col]] leave the army\\n- The cheapest units in the categories exceeding their maximum percentage are disbanded\\n- Additional units cheaper than the new unit are disbanded (up to the maximum number configured)\\n\\nIf disbanding these units is not enough to stay within the limit, the new unit’s recruitment is cancelled instead.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Base amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in an army.\\n\\nA unit's [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost is identical to its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Bonus amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/col]]Army Supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units, per level of the commanding [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_general]]general[[/col]].\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Enables [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for player armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nWhen restricted, the army becomes immobilized until units are either disbanded or transferred to another army.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.
